hero: You built your business on instinct. Grow it on evidence. Small businesses generate real data long before they can justify a data hire. We fill that gap: your sales, customer and campaign numbers, analysed and explained, so you know what's working before you bet on it.
service-01: Cleaning up messy data. We take the data you already hold, wherever it lives, and make it usable before anyone tries to analyse it. Duplicates removed, missing values handled, formats standardised, outliers flagged rather than quietly deleted.
service-02: Dashboards and performance tracking. A place to look every week that tells you how the business is doing, without anyone rebuilding it by hand. A written definition of every number on it, so two people reading it reach the same conclusion.
service-03: Testing whether it's real. Finding out whether a pattern in your numbers is a genuine effect or a coincidence you're about to spend money on. Including when the honest answer is that your data can't settle this yet.
method: Five stages. Each one stops the next being guesswork. Most data work goes wrong because someone decided what to build before finding out what was actually happening.
pricing: From $30. 4 days. 2 revisions. Price and timeline to set. Priced per project.
contact: Tell us about your data. Name, email, organisation, what can we help you with.
